name: qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_bc4w

pin_regs.reason: Explicit RTL pin registers: every functional input (reload, epoch_go, halt, bcfg_*) is captured once at the pin (51 capture flops in 4 reset banks, bcfg_tx/rx_we replicated x4) and every output is a tile output register. A generic extra stage would shift the compiled calendar.

job.purpose: KV link calendar sequencer for the MU release die on the coherent codec2 K22 image (5ae543bfa): boot target 11 cfg merged with the runtime SEG1/SEG2 base writes (bc2 function), rebuilt structurally safe (bc4 = bc3safe structure): RTL 2-stage reset landing with kept copies (every reset source <= 23 loads), per-use kept selector/control copies (functional max 28), sticky fault (sequencer|COL|RUN|STALE|EARLY) on the E face for the parent fault lane. Static, no credits; zero added runtime cycles. PARALLEL fallback geometry (bc2 die slot 21.6x34.56, ~51% util).

structural_change: New safe successor of bc2 (whose native audit found source reset 206/45 loads, an unread fault and E-face pins 2.8 um inside the 21.6 um outline). bc4 = bc3safe structure on the K22 image: 351 FF, source-only synthesis 259 um2 (bc2 same-flow 214 vs daemon 265 => measured gate 264 um2). Outline 21.6 x 34.56: core 17.28 x 30.24 = 522.5 um2 -> ~51% util at the expected daemon area, aspect 1.60. Pins regenerated on the real faces (full-face, centred), clock centre of S.

reset_landing.reason: The RTL owns the 2-stage landing at the face: rst_n -> land0 (1 load) -> 4 kept land1 copies (synchronous assert and release, as the frozen generated landing), then rel0 -> 19 kept rel1 release copies; every reset source drives <= 23 loads (bc3safe census c494be2d7: raw reset 1, outer Q max 23, inner Q max 16). A flow landing would add 2 more release edges to the scheduled constant.
